approvalNote: single-letter class is A (approved) or P (provisional tail); ':e' suffix marks an estimated daily mean (often ice-affected) as filed; 'P:[4]' is one provisional value with a remark flag, kept as filed
checksumNote: sum over rows of Math.round(dischargeCfs*1000); every filed value carries at most 1 decimal, so the product is float-exact
label: Cushing/Payne USGS streamflow, daily confounder, not busy
missingRule: NWIS publishes one row per day; a missing day would be an absent row, never a 0 — the span is gapless, so nothing was filled
source: USGS Waterservices NWIS DV JSON-equivalent RDB, keyless HTTPS
stationPick: nearest Payne County DV stream gage to Cushing town center (12.8 km); only Payne DV gage still active (Yale 07163300 ends 2018-08-20, Perkins 07161000 ends 1991-09-30); no Cushing-named OK gage carries DV data
unit: discharge_cfs = daily mean discharge in cubic feet per second, as filed
